comment: 45yo female, germline CHEK2 c.1100delC truncating variant confirmed on multi-gene panel ordered for moderate family history (maternal grandmother breast 60s, maternal aunt CRC 70s). No personal cancer. CHEK2 c.1100delC carriers: breast cancer RR ~2.0-3.0 (lifetime ~20-30%), CRC RR ~1.5-2.0, prostate cancer high-grade enrichment for males. Most common moderate-penetrance variant in European-ancestry cohorts. Fires RF-CHEK2-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: breast, CRC, prostate). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-CHEK2-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (annual mammography from age 40 + MRI consideration; CRC: colonoscopy from age 40 with q5y interval per NCCN); alternative = IND-CHEK2-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + general-population screening cadence).
